task: T-110 — what spending 80-100 % of the tile's crossovers on hinges does to the sheet
conditions: T = 300 K, k_BT = 4.141947 pN nm; aqueous 2 mM MgCl2; 40.0 x 40.35 nm tile, 15 duplexes at the SAXS-measured 2.69 nm; 8 symmetrically centred crossover columns; C-0022's SOLVED edge profile at 2 mM, 10 nm, 0.192 V; C-0017's 33.3333 pN/nm mandate as n equal springs
decision: A hinge line is a set of crossovers sharing ONE interface and ONE PAIR OF BODIES (C-0040), and k_theta is the interhelical DIHEDRAL constant, so a crossover that hinges a flexure arm is a crossover that no longer joins its two sheet duplexes. The two uses are EXCLUSIVE AT THE SITE: a consumed crossover supplies neither the dihedral spring nor the vertical link.

bounds.name: the crossovers a CONNECTED sheet can spend, 56-crossover phases
bounds.settles: a pigeonhole: 14 interfaces need one retained crossover each, so 56 - 14 = 42

bounds.name: the same as a fraction of the inventory
bounds.settles: 75.0 %, against C-0046's admissible region of 80-100 % — EVERY point of it is above

bounds.name: the same at the 49-crossover phases
bounds.settles: 71.4 %, i.e. the twenty-two seven-column phases are worse, not better

bounds.name: the pieces C-0046's best design leaves, by pigeonhole alone
bounds.settles: 45 spent leaves 11 retained over 14 interfaces, so at least 3 empty and 4 pieces

bounds.name: the pieces C-0046's 100 % design leaves
bounds.settles: no crossover survives, so the sheet is fifteen unconnected duplexes

findings: HINGE USE AND INTERFACE USE ARE EXCLUSIVE AT THE SITE, and the consequence is a pigeonhole, not a degradation. A connected sheet needs one retained crossover on each of its 14 interfaces, so at most 42 of 56 (75.0 %) can be spent — and C-0046's admissible region is 80-100 %. Every design in it severs the sheet: 45 spent leaves at least 4 pieces, 50 at least 9, and 56 leaves fifteen separate duplexes.

D_perp DOES NOT DEGRADE LINEARLY, IT COLLAPSES. Bending across the helices is 14 hinge lines in SERIES, so the rigidity is a harmonic mean and one empty interface annihilates it: the smeared reading falls from 3.397 to 0.667 pN nm at 45 spent (20 % of it left) while the honest one is EXACTLY ZERO, and the anisotropy goes from 25.6 to unbounded. A continuum plate can only express the first, which is the whole excess.

FLATNESS UNDER C-0022's SOLVED LOAD IS CHEAP UP TO THE CEILING AND EXPENSIVE PAST IT. On C-0015's 3 x 15 grid the tile dishes 0.218 of the stroke intact, 0.242 at the 42-crossover connected ceiling (+11 %) and 0.465 at 45 (2.13x) — the step is at severance, not at consumption. Uncoupled the same step runs 0.308 to 0.564. T-5b's convention is 0.10 and nothing in this study reaches it, which is CH-0034's saturation, not a new failure.

THE LOAD DISTRIBUTION IMPROVES WHILE THE SHEET FAILS, and the two are the same fact. The peak per-load-path crossover force falls from 0.150 pN intact to 0.105 pN at 45 spent and to exactly zero at 56 — because a crossover that has been removed cannot be overloaded. C-0026's exact zero is reached by DELETING the load path, not by balancing it, and the duplex shear runs the other way: 0.82 pN against 0.79 pN, against the 65 pN nicked ceiling.

C-0010's INSENSITIVITY IS CORRECT AND IT IS NOT THE RELEVANT CHANNEL. A 2x change in D_perp moves the SMEARED PLATE by 2.5 %, and this study reproduces that: the plate's area RMS moves 31.1 % over the whole consumption range. The LATTICE moves 81.6 % at 45 spent and 117.3 % at 56 — 4x more — because a crossover is TWO elements and only one of them is D_perp: the vertical link is a CONSTRAINT tying two duplex surfaces together, it carries no bending rigidity at all, and a continuum plate has no way to represent its removal.

THE HINGE SITES ARE NOT AN ATTACHMENT GRID, so the generous 'a hinge IS an attachment' reading is the worse design and not the better one. At 45 spent the coupling attached at its own hinge sites dishes 1.535 of the stroke against 0.465 on C-0015's 3 x 15 grid — 3.3x at the SAME path count — and puts 1.79 pN on a crossover against 0.1054. A crossover lattice is a 32 bp x 2.69 nm lattice with a parity, and a flatness grid is three columns of fifteen rows; they are different shapes, which is C-0015's own lesson in a new place.

THE CONNECTED CEILING IS 42 PATHS AND IT DOES CLEAR SECTION 3's ACCEPTABLE STROKE: a 42-path E5a array places an arm of 8.882 nm and delivers 3.063 nm of usable stroke against the 3 nm clause. C-0046 bracketed the path-count threshold at 34 < n <= 45 and did not resolve it; it is 39 paths. So the branch survives on a sheet in one piece over the window 39 <= n <= 42, and NONE of C-0046's three reported designs is in it.
